Actual wait-admission output binds task, blocker or reasoning request, causal dependency, changing condition/source/actor/mechanism, poll identity, next check, maximum horizon/expiry, owner action and independent work. Its applicable findings include WAIT_CONDITION_NOT_ACTIONABLE, WAIT_WITHOUT_ADMISSION, GITHUB_UPDATE_WAIT_WITHOUT_CAUSAL_DEPENDENCY, WAIT_REASONING_HANDOFF_MISSING and WAIT_NEXT_CHECK_OUTSIDE_HORIZON. A rejected wait continues known independent work.
